title: The queue callback imports the full Stamphog worker stack
problem: This callback runs on the TaskRun save path. `queue_inbox_pr_review` imports `products.stamphog.backend.tasks.tasks` before it publishes the Celery message. That module loads the GitHub and Temporal clients at module scope. A clean post-setup import took about 0.6 seconds locally. Each web process pays this delay once and retains those modules.
suggestion: Publish the task by its registered name with `current_app.send_task`, as other cross-product facades do. Alternatively, add a lightweight task wrapper that imports the handler only inside the Celery worker. Keep the live save path limited to message serialization and publication.
